purpose: Validate the canonical grammar model against six structurally different chapter types before mass canonicalization of all 168 chapters.

pilots.selection_reason: Simple person/number endings plus common stem-ending behavior; tests conjugation tables and form-building exercises.

pilots.title_de: Das ist der Mann, der immer meine Nachbarin besucht
pilots.selection_reason: Tests subordinate-clause word order, antecedent agreement and sentence-combination exercises without prematurely merging later relative-pronoun case concepts.
Tests Satzklammer, position fields, inversion, verb-first structures and multi-pattern word-order representation.
Tests a large tense/form matrix, actor/instrument/cause complements and active-passive transformation.

anti_duplication_rule: Concept identity is semantic. Pilot concept IDs may later absorb additional source chapters that teach the same semantic concept; a new source chapter does not automatically create a new concept.
next_action: Capture source-supported canonical rules/patterns for all six pilots, validate field adequacy, then decide whether the contract needs revision before mass canonicalization.
